title: Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt
author: Cail Daley
description: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt key-project paper for SPT-3G: the overlap, the TR1 analysis, first blinded posteriors, the covariance plans, open questions, the SPT products needed and Euclid external-collaborator access.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt paper, for SPT-3G.

sections.title: SPT × Euclid
sections.outline: The overlap with Euclid, the DR1 timeline, the CMBX KP2-3 papers and the SPT × Euclid paper among them, and what SPT-3G adds over ACT DR6.

sections.title: The TR1 analysis
sections.outline: The pipeline, its validation on GLASS mocks, the blind, the blinded TR1 × SPT-3G data vector and the first blinded posteriors.

sections.title: The covariance plans
sections.outline: The FLASK mock covariance, not yet in the pipeline, and the two routes to put SPT-3G in it.

sections.title: Towards DR1 and DR2
sections.outline: What the analysis needs from SPT, the open scope, combining CMB surveys, the DR2 overlap with SPT-3G, and how to take part.
